integrity: The analytic proof is self-contained once the cited exact distance formula is accepted. The accompanying checker tests algebraic parameter identities and representative finite multisets but is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem reconstructs only the finite multiset of component distances to Euclidean space from the exact profile; it does not reconstruct the summand spaces or dimensions and does not claim numerical stability under noisy profile data. The local asymptotic uses the published exact ell_p-sum distance formula as its premise.
title: Hilbert-point distance profiles recover all summand distortions
